sources.entry: Telegram - Messaging app with a focus on speed and security. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/overtake/TelegramSwift) [![App Store][app-store Icon]](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/telegram/id747648890?platform=mac)

summary.name: Telegram Desktop
summary.one_liner: Telegram Desktop is the official desktop app for the Telegram messaging service, designed to stay in sync with the mobile app.
use_cases: chatting with contacts from a computer
installing a messaging app on a Mac
summary.what_it_does: The page presents Telegram Desktop as a fast and secure desktop messaging app that is kept in sync with the user's mobile phone. It offers a Get Telegram for macOS option that links to the Mac App Store, and a "Show all platforms" link. The software is released under the GPL v3 license, and its source code is available on GitHub. The page itself is brief and does not list specific features beyond syncing and speed/security.
notable: Official desktop client that syncs with the Telegram mobile app
Source code published on GitHub under GPL v3
Available on the Mac App Store
caveats: Page does not list features beyond syncing, speed and security
Other platforms are behind a 'Show all platforms' link and not named on this page
